profile.profile: Nidhi Hooda is the founder of Growpido LLC. The snippets describe her as a reputation architect and strategic influence or narrative advisor. Growpido is a Dubai, U.A.E. based reputation advisory and executive branding company. It says the firm works with founders, fund managers, family offices, and DIFC leaders and CEOs.
